يعتصرون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَصِرُونَ (yaʕtaṣirūna) /jaʕ.ta.sˤi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# يُعْتَصَرُونَ (yuʕtaṣarūna) /juʕ.ta.sˤa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
